bio: Located right in the heart of Glasgow, Carlton George Hotel is the perfect spot for some delicious Afternoon Tea. The boutique hotel is a contemporary yet cosy with a unique rooftop restaurant.  Perched on the 7th floor of the Carlton George Hotel, Window's is the only rooftop restaurant in Glasgow. Here you can enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea while taking in the view over the rooftops and chimney pots of the city.  Tuck into a delicious array of finger sandwiches, scones and preserves, plus mouth-watering sweet treats ranging from carrot cake to tiffin square and many more.  The Carlton George Hotel is located within walking distance to Glasgow Queen Street train station.  Afternoon Tea is priced from £19.95 per person Monday - Friday and £22.95 per person on Saturdays & Sundays. A Children's Afternoon Tea menu is also available, priced from £9.75 per child.
